note: Adapted from the Cryptotermes part of Roonwal & Chhotani, Fauna of India, Isoptera, the first volume; the original is in English. The captions of figures 207 and 208 in the original read Cryptotermes dudleyi (after Chhotani 1970), which does not agree with the species name of the corresponding text and is a case of the book reusing an illustration of another species; the number of cubitus branches in the text is cut off at the edge of the scan window and is not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head capsule subrectangular, width including the eyes equal to or slightly greater than the length to the mandible bases; pronotum flat, subreniform, without a notch at the middle of the anterior and posterior margins; antennae 16—18-segmented, segment 3 usually the shortest; wing surface with papillae and small tubercles; forewing length 7.0—7.5 mm; tibial apical spurs 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented, with arolia.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule pale reddish yellow, yellowish brown to light brown; labrum, antennae and legs yellow; thoracic and abdominal tergites paler than the head capsule, sternites paler than the tergites; wings with a light brown tinge. Head and body with hairs of medium length. Total length with wings 8.5—10.1 mm, without wings 4.6—6.00 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, width including the eyes equal to or slightly greater than the length to the mandible bases (length 1.00—1.03 mm, width 0.97—1.07 mm); Y suture pale. Compound eyes oval, wider anteriorly, at about half their long diameter from the lateral base; longest diameter 0.30—0.33 mm. Ocelli oval, semitransparent, mostly touching the compound eye, sometimes separated by a fine line; length 0.10—0.13 mm, width 0.07—0.10 mm. Antennae 16—18-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than half of segment 1, segment 3 usually the shortest, sometimes as long as segment 2 or 4. Clypeus weakly divided into anteclypeus and postclypeus; anteclypeus without hairs, apical margin straight; postclypeus sparsely hairy on the sides, anterior margin curved outwards. Mandibles of the Cryptotermes type. Pronotum flat, subreniform, length 0.62—0.77 mm, width 0.80—1.30 mm, slightly narrower than the head capsule; anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin slightly convex, neither with a notch at the middle; sides slightly rounded. Legs short, hairy; tibial apical spurs 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented; with arolia. Wings thin, membranous, with a light brown tinge, with papillae, small tubercles and crescent-shaped nodules. Forewing length 7.0—7.5 mm; the radius fuses with the costa between the anterior quarter and third; the radial sector gives off 5—8 branches to the costa, the first separating at about a quarter of the wing membrane; the media curves upwards and meets the radial sector between branches 2 and 5 (the wing of one paratype is abnormally forked, giving off a branch towards the wing apex); the number of cubitus branches lies outside the scan window.
